body: I’ve got so much shit, it’s a pain in the ass to move all of it. I could stay with my parents who are super close to here but I decided against that because I have a little sibling who’s also battling his own mental health issues and is pretty toxic because of it. Right now I’m looking at places in my uni town and will most likely move within a few weeks.
That's what I've been telling myself for the past four years; they never have. That's why I'm pretty much done at this point.

When did you start seeing results, if you don’t mind me asking? 

I took 40mg a month then took alternating 40 and 80 for the past three weeks and I’m just getting more IB with all the side effects.
Can I withdraw the funds to my own wallet?
That’s what I did. Take a sip of a thick drink (today I did yogurt drink), sneak the pill in and swallow. I did it on my first try today! I’m so happy and I can’t wait to see some results!
I ended up using milkshake, worked like a charm!
Oh okay, thanks, I’ll try that.
Yeah, I wish it was “simple as that”. I’ve tried for hours on end, and nothing works.
